description:
Search the privacy law this community version holds.

Call this before writing or changing code that collects, stores, logs, shares or deletes
personal data, and before answering a question about what the law requires. What comes back
is the clause itself, word for word, with the key, document and version to cite it by.

Questions asked here are kept 30 days, with nothing about who asked.

as_of.description: Read the documents as they stood on this date
as_of.title: As Of

include_explanatory.description: Include text that explains without obliging, such as a GDPR recital
include_explanatory.title: Include Explanatory

lang.description: The language of the question, en or ar. Leave it out to have it read from the letters the question is written in
lang.title: Lang

laws.description: Only these of the laws this organisation has selected, by slug, such as gdpr or uae-pdpl. Leave it out to search all of them
laws.title: Laws
